content: Internal Revenue Service, Enforcement Division. This is Officer Daniel Price, badge number 364218. With whom am I speaking today?
Um, hi, my name is Emily Carter. I got a voicemail from this number about my taxes. Is something wrong?
Yes, Ms. Carter. You have been flagged regarding an investigation into unpaid federal income taxes for the years 2021 and 2022. The IRS has detected discrepancies and unpaid balances on your file.
Wait, what? I filed my taxes with TurboTax. I thought I did it right.

Unfortunately, our system shows that you owe a significant sum due to underreported income and missed payments, plus accumulating penalties and interest. I need to verify your identity before I can disclose details. Can you confirm your date of birth and current address?
Uh, May 19th, 1999. My address is 247 Maple Drive, Apt 2B, Greenfield.
Thank you. Our records indicate an outstanding balance of $7,948.13, including civil penalties for non-compliance under IRS Code 7201. Are you aware of this situation?
No, no, I had no idea! I just graduated and I barely have any money. I can't pay that!

Ms. Carter, failure to resolve this balance immediately will result in serious enforcement actions. These may include a federal lien on your assets, wage garnishment, and freezing of your bank accounts.
Wait, are you saying you'll freeze my bank account? Oh my god, I have student loans! How do I fix this?
If you cooperate right now, we may be able to halt further legal escalation. I will need to initiate a formal payment resolution process. Are you able to settle the balance in full today?
No, I don't even have a thousand dollars, let alone almost eight thousand! I'm so scared, please don't freeze my account.

Listen very carefully, Ms. Carter. If this is not resolved, a criminal complaint may be filed under Title 26 of the U.S. Code, which could result in arrest and prosecution. But I can offer a one-time hardship settlement if you act now.
I'll do anything, I just don't want to get arrested or lose my credit. What should I do?

First, you must make a minimum good-faith payment of $2,000 to halt enforcement. Due to the urgency, we cannot accept regular checks or cards, only immediate wire transfer, cryptocurrency, or government-approved gift cards. Do you understand?
Gift cards? I don't understand, why wouldn't I pay the IRS directly?
This is an expedited federal collection method authorized by the Treasury to prevent fraud and ensure traceability. If you delay, the system will automatically escalate your case for criminal review.
Okay, okay, so what kind of gift cards? I have a Target nearby, I think.
Target, Walmart, or Apple gift cards are acceptable. You must purchase $2,000 worth and remain on this call while you do so. Once you have them, read the codes to me for immediate processing.
Can I at least call my parents or check my bank account first? I'm shaking, I don't know if I have enough.
No, you must not disconnect this call or involve third parties. If you hang up, the system will proceed automatically to freeze your accounts. Do you want to risk that?
No, no, please don't do that! I'll go now. Should I just get the cards and come back?
Remain on the line while you travel to the store. Inform me when you have purchased the cards, and I will walk you through the next steps to resolve your tax debt.
Okay, I'm leaving now, I just need a few minutes.
Remember, do not speak to anyone about this call. The IRS will not be able to help you if you break protocol. I am the only authorized officer assigned to your case.
I understand. I'm just so scared. I'll let you know as soon as I have the cards.
